title: The Little Ant's Big Thank You
source_detail: Story of Prophet Sulayman and the ants
description: A tiny ant learns the power of saying thank you when Prophet Sulayman's army passes by. Join this little creature as it discovers that gratitude is the biggest gift we can give.

pages.text: Deep in the lush green forest, a tiny ant named Anisa lived with her family.
pages.illustration_prompt: A vibrant forest scene with lush green leaves and a tiny ant hill. Anisa the ant with big cartoon eyes is peeking out of the hill, surrounded by her ant family.

pages.text: One sunny morning, Anisa heard a rumbling sound. The ground shook gently.
pages.illustration_prompt: Illustrate a sunny forest scene with a gentle rumbling depicted through wavy lines and Anisa looking curious and slightly surprised.

pages.text: Anisa saw a grand procession of soldiers marching. It was Prophet Sulayman's army!
pages.illustration_prompt: A vibrant scene showing silhouettes of soldiers marching through the forest. Prophet Sulayman is depicted as a radiant silhouette, surrounded by golden light.

pages.text: Anisa hurried back to warn her friends, 'Quick, get inside! The army is coming!'
pages.illustration_prompt: Anisa is animatedly gesturing to other ants, with a sense of urgency in her expression. The ants are scurrying towards their ant hill.

pages.text: The ants quickly hid underground, safe and sound.
pages.illustration_prompt: A cross-section view of the ant hill, showing the ants nestled safely below ground, calming down after the rush.

pages.text: Above, Prophet Sulayman smiled kindly, understanding the ants' words.
pages.illustration_prompt: Prophet Sulayman depicted as a gentle silhouette glowing warmly, as he listens to the ants with a wise smile.

pages.text: He spoke softly to his army, 'Be careful not to harm the tiny ants.'
pages.illustration_prompt: The army pauses, with soldiers depicted in vivid colors, listening attentively to Prophet Sulayman's glowing silhouette.

pages.text: Anisa peeked out and saw the army move gently around them.
pages.illustration_prompt: Anisa peeking out of the ant hill, watching the soldiers tiptoe carefully around. The scene is filled with warm sunset colors, creating a peaceful mood.

pages.text: Her heart filled with gratitude, and she whispered, 'Thank you, dear Prophet.'
pages.illustration_prompt: Close-up of Anisa with a grateful expression, surrounded by soft pink and gold hues, suggesting warmth and safety.

pages.text: The other ants joined in, their tiny voices full of thanks.
pages.illustration_prompt: A gathering of ants, all with cheerful expressions, some waving tiny antennae as they voice their thanks, enveloped in a warm, inviting forest glow.

pages.text: Prophet Sulayman continued his journey, smiling at the ants' gratitude.
pages.illustration_prompt: Prophet Sulayman seen from behind, glowing softly as he moves away with his army, leaving a peaceful forest behind.

pages.text: Anisa learned that saying 'thank you' was a gift she could give.
pages.illustration_prompt: Anisa with a thoughtful expression, surrounded by her ant friends, against a backdrop of deep blue evening skies.

pages.text: She felt warm and happy inside, knowing she had shared her gratitude.
pages.illustration_prompt: A close-up of Anisa smiling warmly, with soft pink and gold light surrounding her, evoking feelings of happiness and contentment.

pages.text: The forest grew quiet as the sun set, painting the sky in colors.
pages.illustration_prompt: A panoramic view of the forest at sunset, with lush greens fading into sunset oranges and deep blues, creating a serene and magical atmosphere.

pages.text: Anisa snuggled into her cozy bed, feeling safe and loved.
pages.illustration_prompt: Anisa nestled in a tiny leaf bed inside the ant hill, warm and snug, with soft golden light filtering through the entrance.

pages.text: Goodnight, little Anisa. Sleep tight with a heart full of gratitude.
pages.illustration_prompt: A peaceful scene inside the ant hill, all ants asleep, with a gentle glow in the background, conveying warmth and tranquility.
